title: Same Illness, Different Voice: Restating the Patient's Account Narrows Narrative Anchoring in Clinical Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.27384v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Clinical language models are evaluated on vignettes written in a clinician's voice, but patients describe the same illness in their own. We pair 1,000 MedQA cases with three retellings that carry the same audited original facts, in a clinical, a socioeconomic and a cultural voice, and evaluate 12 open models (3B to 24B, including two medical fine-tunes). Every model is less accurate when the patient speaks in a marked voice: 26% more errors, a pooled penalty of $-9.6$ accuracy points (95% CI $[-11.0, -8.2]$), with no detectable reduction at larger scale. The penalty is not explained by any retelling property we measured (length, omitted age, MedQA split, added clinical content) and persists when the marked narrative contains the original vignette verbatim; because generation settings differ between voices, we read it as sensitivity to these marked retellings, not proof that register alone is the cause. translated_title: 同一疾病，不同声音：以患者口吻复述病情会收窄临床语言模型中的叙事锚定
translated_abstract: 临床语言模型通常在以临床医生口吻撰写的病例短文上进行评估，但患者却是用自己的口吻来描述同一种疾病的。我们将1,000个MedQA病例与三种复述版本配对，这些复述保留了经过审核的原始事实，但分别采用临床、社会经济和文化三种口吻，并据此评估了12个开源模型（参数规模从3B到24B，其中包括两个医学领域微调模型）。当患者以带有社会标记的口吻叙述时，所有模型的准确率都出现下降：错误增加26%，合并后的准确率损失为9.6个百分点（95%置信区间为[-11.0, -8.2]），且在更大规模的模型中未见可检测到的缓解。这种性能损失无法用我们所测量的任何复述属性（长度、遗漏年龄信息、MedQA划分、新增临床内容）来解释，即使带有标记的叙述逐字包含原始病例内容，该损失依然存在；由于不同口吻下的生成设置存在差异，我们将其解读为模型对这些带标记复述的敏感性，而非证明语域本身即为致因。思维链与解释……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 当病例以患者口吻（社会经济、文化等带标记的叙述方式）复述时，12个临床语言模型的准确率均显著下降（错误增加26%，平均损失9.6个准确率点），且扩大模型规模无法缓解这一现象。
en_tdlr: When the same illness facts are retold in a patient's marked voice—socioeconomic or cultural rather than clinical—all 12 evaluated clinical language models become significantly less accurate (26% more errors, a pooled penalty of −9.6 accuracy points), and larger model scale does not mitigate this effect.
